acceptance: Unresolved oracle thread -> oracle-gate failure; resolving it flips to success within bridge or sweep latency (observed on a real PR)
A valid stand-in flips the gate; extra text does not
A PR editing oracle-verdict.yml, oracle-review.yml or oracle_gate.py cannot change its own gate result (runs develop code)
Unit tests for decide parity with oracle_review_check
description: The required oracle-review check runs from the PR's own copy of oracle-review.yml (pull_request), and the ruleset requires the context without an integration_id, so a PR can weaken the check that judges it. oracle-verdict cannot carry gate semantics: the hosted post job and the planned local executor both write it. Owner decision: new context oracle-gate. Add standalone _project/scripts/oracle_gate.py outside _project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/ (which the oracle-local plan freezes then deletes), reusing oracle_review_check.decide semantics, run from pull_request_target, issue_comment (stand-in), a workflow_run bridge from review and thread events, and the hourly sweep; it is the only writer of oracle-gate, via the oracle App. Exempt-only -> success; SHIP with no unresolved oracle threads -> success; valid stand-in for the exact head -> success; else failure.
